think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed value domain. 2) Check whether the knob is primarily numeric with an inherent ordering. 3) If numeric, look for documented sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just a smaller/larger quantity. 4) If the knob is non-numeric (string/enum/list/boolean), it does not fit the ‘special numerical knob’ definition; classify as not special under this criterion. 5) If it is numeric and has such sentinel values, mark special_knob=true and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise false.
